scripts.release:patch: pnpm version patch && pnpm run push -- --skip-bump && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm version minor && pnpm run push -- --skip-bump && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm version major && pnpm run push -- --skip-bump && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:local: pnpm test && node tools/test-outcome-run.js --outcomes test-results/outcomes-playwright.json --no-probe -- pnpm exec playwright test --project=no_live_session
scripts.test:live: node tools/test-outcome-run.js --outcomes test-results/outcomes-playwright.json --env sit -- pnpm exec playwright test --project=live && pnpm run test:gaslogger
scripts.test:regression: pnpm run test:local && pnpm run test:live
